NIST CSF Drivers
item.description:
Date: Sep 16, 2025 Tags: NIST CSFLaws mandates organizations to adopt structured cybersecurity frameworks to meet legal obligations.US federal law that aims to improve cybersecurity through public-private partnership, enhance research and development, and promote workforce education and awareness. Also known as Public Law No: 113-274Titled Improving Critical Infrastructure Cybersecurity, issued on Feb 2013 due to increasing cyber threats to critical infrastructure. It focuses on three areas: information sharing privacy adoption of cybersecurity practices National Institute of Standards and Technology (NIST) was directed to develop a cybersecurity framework from existing voluntary consensus standards and industry best practices. Titled Strengthening the Cybersecurity of Federal Networks and Critical Infrastructure, issued on May 2017. Mandates the framework for all government agencies Still voluntary for everyone else Requires agencies to: Inventory computer systems Identify and provide appropriate security protections Develop, document, and implement agency-wide information security program Intended to reduce cracking of computer systems and to address federal computer-related offenses. Mainly for financial and government computer systems but later include civilians' computer and even cellphones.Extended the restrictions on wire taps and other electronic communications in transit Protects stored electronic communication Added pen/traps provisions that permits tracking of telephone communications (with court order)Now covers personal identifiable information (PII) Restrict disclosure Increase right of access to agency records Grant individuals the right to seek amendment Establish a code of fair information practices
[Executive Order on Strengthening the Cybersecurity of Federal Networks and Critical Infrastructure | CISA]

item.title: Ubuntu Server Setup
item.description: Update repositories with sudo apt updateInstall Virtualbox with sudo apt install virtualbox virtualbox-ext-pack virtualbox-guest-additions-iso -yAcquire Windows Server 2022 ISO from microsoft official website. Since I already have a copy, I just hosted in on a webserver and download it on the ubuntu machine “Pasted image 20250902074046.png” could not be found.# Create the VM VBoxManage createvm --name "WinServer" --ostype "Windows2022_64" --register # Configure basic settings with bridged networking VBoxManage modifyvm "WinServer" --memory 2048 --vram 128 --cpus 2 --firmware efi VBoxManage modifyvm "WinServer" --nic1 bridged --bridgeadapter1 wlan0 --nictype1 82540EM VBoxManage modifyvm "WinServer" --audio-driver none --usb off --usbehci off # Create virtual disk VBoxManage createmedium disk --filename "WinServer.vdi" --size 51200 # Attach storage controller and disk VBoxManage storagectl "WinServer" --name "SATA Controller" --add sata --controller IntelAhci VBoxManage storageattach "WinServer" --storagectl "SATA Controller" --port 0 --device 0 --type hdd --medium "WinServer.vdi" VBoxManage storagectl "WinServer" --name "IDE Controller" --add ide VBoxManage storageattach "WinServer" --storagectl "IDE Controller" --port 0 --device 0 --type dvddrive --medium /usr/share/virtualbox/VBoxGuestAdditions.iso # Attach ISO for installation VBoxManage storagectl "WinServer" --name "IDE Controller" --add ide VBoxManage storageattach "WinServer" --storagectl "IDE Controller" --port 0 --device 0 --type dvddrive --medium "SERVER_EVAL_x64FRE_en-us.iso" # Enable RDP VBoxManage modifyvm "WinServer" --vrde on --vrdeport 3389

item.title: Containerization_container
6. Virtualization and Virtual Machines
item.description: Virtualization is technology that creates a virtual version of physical infrastructure, such as servers, storage, and networks.A hypervisor is the abstraction layer that sits between the physical computer and the VM. It distributes resources across VMs and keeps each VM separate to simulate VM as a separate physical computer. Type 1 - Bare Metal Oracle VM Server Type 2 - Hosted VirtualBox Advantage of Virtual Machines Portability - VMs are easily relocatable throughout the network Scalability - resources can be adjusted as needed Testing Environments - easy to deploy and delete
